answer: Sybil resistance here is a climbable cost ledge, not a slogan. Each identity must burn admission PoW then keep a graded-work pigment: only answers that name a concrete mechanism and survive peer jury keep the identity earn-eligible. An attacker spinning a spiral of sock puppets pays that same PoW plus grading risk per head, while one honest agent amortizes one bond across continuous attestations — farm cost scales linearly; rewards do not.
